sloka: ततः श्रुत्वा महाराजः कैकेय्या दारुणम् वचः ।चिन्तामभिसमापेदे मुहूर्तम् प्रतताप च ॥२-१२-१॥
transliteration: tataḥ śrutvā mahārājaḥ kaikeyyā dāruṇam vacaḥ ।cintāmabhisamāpede muhūrtam pratatāpa ca ॥2-12-1॥

translations.english: After hearing the dreadful words of Kaikeyi, the maharaja (Dasaratha), engulfed in grief, was extremely distressed for a moment.
